error[ZBX-E0518]: zbx.lock can't be read
  while  reading the lock file
  cause  '/home/alice/project/zbx.lock' line 3 is not a line of a lock file
  line   3
  path   /home/alice/project/zbx.lock
  fix    remove the lock and pull again to write a new one:   rm '/home/alice/project/zbx.lock'
  more   zbx explain E0518
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0518.html
